label: played at sporting venue
definition: Sporting competitor or team X played a game or competition at venue Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit play-at or game-at with X as competitor; a completed win or loss at Y establishing competitive play there; historical sporting venue use. Excludes: ordinary attendance, practice, or employment at a place; plans without established play; the opponent or event substituted for the venue. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: future scheduled play without realization; unclear competitor versus spectator role; a generic at-venue phrase without a game context. Narrower than physical presence. It does not assert that Y is the permanent home stadium.

facts.reason: Jets → Giants Stadium: Explicit play-at and game/victory/loss-at rows establish competitive play at the venue.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
